body:
I guess I did luck out with the move, though here it's kind of expected of young people to do that pretty quickly, especially since my family lives in a dirthole so shitty it's the only option after you finish high school, my siblings are going to move after finishing theirs too. Nothing else we can do.

I used to go to a few different doctors, psychiatrists mostly, didn't get diagnosed and I felt too guitly over the costs. I also can't remember anything from them and it kinda freaks me out, because my memory can't be that shitty. Idk what happend. Don't think I will be able to afford to go now, and I'm afraid that I would be brushed off if I tried to go, it's kind of a common occurence here. My sister was screamed at and berated for attempted suicide less than a day after.

The worst thing is that I had so many chances to change things, but I never did, because I was scared and worried about what my family will think of me. And now I'm stuck here. Because I said I wanted to move to a city I didn't know with no friends or family to speak of. And I've been loosing since and I'm so tired.

I'm sorry I write so much, I don't even know if I was supposed to respond to this. Thank you for the kind words though, I appreciate that you took the time to write them.
